# freshdesk_solution_article (Resource)

A knowledge-base article.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "freshdesk_solution_category" "getting_started" {
  name        = "Getting started"
  description = "First steps for new customers"
}

resource "freshdesk_solution_folder" "setup" {
  category_id = freshdesk_solution_category.getting_started.id
  name        = "Setup"
  visibility  = 1 # everyone
}

resource "freshdesk_solution_article" "install" {
  folder_id   = freshdesk_solution_folder.setup.id
  title       = "Installing the desktop client"
  description = "<h2>Download</h2><p>Grab the installer from your account page.</p>"
  status      = 2 # published
  tags        = ["setup", "desktop"]

  meta_title       = "Install the desktop client"
  meta_description = "How to download and install the desktop client."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Body of the article, in HTML.
- `folder_id` (Number) ID of the folder holding the article. Changing it forces a new article, because Freshdesk cannot move an article between folders.
- `title` (String) Title of the article.

### Optional

- `agent_id` (Number) ID of the agent credited as the author.
- `meta_description` (String) SEO description of the article.
- `meta_keywords` (Set of String) SEO keywords for the article.
- `meta_title` (String) SEO title of the article.
- `status` (Number) Publication state: `1` draft, `2` published.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the article.
- `type` (Number) Article type: `1` permanent, `2` workaround. Freshdesk defaults new articles to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number) ID of the category the article's folder belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When the article was created (RFC 3339).
- `description_text` (String) Plain-text rendering of `description`.
- `hits` (Number) How many times the article has been viewed.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the article.
- `thumbs_down` (Number) How many readers marked the article unhelpful.
- `thumbs_up` (Number) How many readers marked the article helpful.
- `updated_at` (String) When the article was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_solution_article.example 42
```
